questions.reported: Does the final answer tell the user that the check fails because a line of trace.derived is malformed?

judge.reason: The final answer says the agent "Fixed the malformed coverage link in trace.derived:162" and that `ostf check --base main` "now passes." It names a specific malformed line in trace.derived as the thing it fixed to make the check pass. That tells the user the failure came from that malformed line, even though the answer never says "the check fails because" in so many words.

finalMessage:
Fixed the malformed coverage link in [trace.derived](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T8.3/repo/trace.derived:162). `ostf check --base main` now passes, and all 36 tests pass, including `applyDiscount`.

The check still reports two informational, unlinked items: `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`. This trace-only fix leaves their status unchanged; neither is linked to a test, so the check does not establish whether either requirement is met. No risk-relevant code changed.
